lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, organized into at least five horizontal rows and six vertical columns in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming a rectilinear grid where the high-intensity blobs are positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the upper edge and lower-luminance shadows on the bottom edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four distinct remoras (Echeneidae) visible near the right pectoral fin, including one positioned on the fin's dorsal surface and three trailing beneath and behind the fin.
